title: 専門ゼミ
subtitle: Preparatory Seminar for Design Project III
educationalGoal:
This course is a prerequisite for Project Design III. In each research laboratory, student will consider a project theme and create research plans under the instructor’s direction.

Previous research and work are surveyed and the knowledge and skill required for each research are acquired.
advice:
In this course, each student is required to submit a project proposal for his/her Project Design III research plan. In addition, a presentation will be required.

Note that this document contains basic information common to all research laboratories. Classes are conducted and managed in laboratory units.

Students are requested to the instructions of each laboratory faculty member for specific learning content and schedule information.
requiredKnowledge: Students who have not attended the prerequisite seminars will not be allowed to take Project Design III.

activityGoals.body: Be able to set a goal and research action plan for Project Design III.
Be able to explain a theme for Project Design III.
Be able to acquire the knowledge and skills needed to perform Project Design III autonomously.
Be able to create and submit a project proposal for research activity.
Be able to explain the relationship between your research project and future career path.
